items.quote: There is an increase in the DSO days from 62 days in March 2024 to 65 days in September 2024. Clearly , there is seasonality. You can see that last year, from September 2023 to Q2 FY2024, it was 67 days, and it has come down to 62 days. So, we have no concerns about our receivables.

items.statement: Net cash and treasury surplus net of debt increased by Rs. 77 crores to Rs. 5,090 crores between March and September 2024
items.quote: Our total net cash and treasury surplus, which is total cash and treasury surplus net of debt, stands at Rs. 5,090 crores. If you see between March and September, there is an increase of about Rs. 77 crores in the net treasury and cash surplus, driven by a reduction in debt, as well as an increase in the overall gross treasury and cash surplus.

items.statement: Search and survey conducted in Nov-Dec 2023; show cause notice received and company is replying to it
items.quote: We have been making disclosures as required since the quarter ending December 2023. There was a search and survey conducted in November -December last year. We have updated this disclosure on our publication page. A show cause notice has been received, and we are in the process of replying to it. That is the current status.

items.statement: Cash before Flipkart deal was around Rs. 550 crores, received Rs. 95 crores from deal, total around Rs. 675 crores
items.quote: The cash before Flipkart deal, it was around Rs. 550 crores and we got another Rs. 95 crores. So, Rs. 550 crores plus Rs. 95 crores is around Rs. 675 crores.

items.statement: Expect to have Rs. 550 crores cash after profitability of SastaSundar platform
items.quote: And still after the profitability of the SastaSundar platform, we will be having Rs. 550 crores, so you can say the treasury will be as it is

items.statement: No additional capital raise planned; growth to be funded from internal cash and Flipkart deal proceeds
items.quote: this is without raising any additional capital. So, out of our own capital which we raised, we got around Rs. 96 crores funds from Flipkart deal, and out of some treasury income we have to add around Rs. 55 crores only.

items.statement: Interest cost and depreciation higher due to new plant and office expenses
items.quote: My interest cost and depreciation was obviously much higher than last year because on account of the expenses that we've made towards the new plant, the new office and everything, which is still to give you results, right?

items.statement: Preferential shares allotted in March remain unlisted due to regulatory conflict between paid-up capital exceeding Rs 325 crore threshold requiring main board migration and mandatory three-year SME board tenure; company filed SEBI waiver ap
items.quote: we had scouted for investments and once we got a confirmation from BSE, in terms of getting their in principle approval, that is the time that we had actually called for the money. So the money was called for, the shares were issued from our side as far as we are concerned and we had filed for PAS 3 also.

items.statement: Company filed waiver application under Regulation 300 on 24 October seeking relaxation of mandatory three-year SME board period to enable main board migration and listing of preferential shares.
items.quote: on 24th of October, we have filed for a waiver under regulation 300 that will give us a relaxation for this mandatory three year period. So we have asked SEBI to give us a waiver on that front, so that we can migrate early.

items.statement: If SEBI waiver is denied, organic migration to main board will occur by 15 September 2025 upon completion of three-year SME board tenure.
items.quote: the last, so to say the last limit for this entire issue would be that next year, September 15th, we are due to migrate organically. We will be completing the three year period for which is required and hence that will happen.

items.statement: Warrant money will be called on schedule with no change despite preferential share listing delay.
items.quote: We will be call for warrant money on schedule. There'll be no change there.

items.statement: Cash generated from operations was lower due to plant delays increasing in-house losses, though cost of goods sold was lower improving margins
items.quote: The cash generated from business operations basically, what happened this time was that the operations that we have and the cost of producing goods was relatively lower.

items.statement: Plant delays caused higher in-house losses but lower cost of goods sold improved margins and cash generation
items.quote: So basically, the main reason for the cash generation was that the markets increased, our stock levels increased, our cash generation increased. But our plants were also delayed.

items.statement: Company planning preferential issue for garmenting and yarn manufacturing expansion, amount and mode not finalized
items.quote: It will be a preferential. So we haven't decided the mode -- the total mode yet, but we are mostly focused towards preferential.

items.statement: Board approved raising up to 150 crores via QIP or other permissible modes subject to approvals
items.quote: The Board has also approved raising an additional up to 150 crores through equity shares or other eligible securities via a qualified institutional placement or other permissible modes subject to necessary approvals to fund not just the above opportunities but others that are also on the horizon.

items.statement: Rights issue approval received but not exercised due to share price run-up; QIP and rights issue are enabling resolutions for equity portion
items.quote: As we had indicated in the overall plan that we want to look at a combination of debt, equity and internal accruals, we continue to maintain that same balance as far as the deployment of the funds is concerned.

name: S H Kelkar and Company Ltd

items.statement: Inventory at highest level, will be brought down towards year end
items.quote: We expect that the inventory level at this point is at the highest. And we will slowly be bringing it down towards the end of the year.

items.statement: Expect lower debt by year end from free cash flow and insurance payout
items.quote: Also operationally we are reducing the debt as we generate free cash flow month on month plus we have the expectation o f the insurance payout before the end of the year

items.statement: DSO expected to reduce to around 135 days by end of FY26
items.quote: DSO will reduce to around 135 days.

items.statement: Uravi currently holds 47.39% of SKL and will reach 50.01% by November end, with total investment of around INR12.5 crores at that stake.
items.quote: I will answer that currently we are holding 47.39% and by November end Uravi will be holding 50.01% of SKL currently.

items.statement: SKL contributed only about INR4-4.5 lakh to consolidated results in H1 FY25 as the acquisition closed on 25th September; full consolidation will appear in Q3 FY25.
items.quote: Since the transaction happened on 25th of September, we could only add around INR4 lakh or INR4.5 lakh maybe numbers I am not sure, but one week's profit of SKL only.

items.statement: Cash and cash equivalents of around ₹137 crores as per presentation
items.quote: As you would have seen in the presentation, we are currently sitting on around ₹137 crores of cash and cash equivalents.

items.statement: Indirect costs increased by Rs 5.5 crore in Q2 FY25 due to restructuring, increments, and new business hiring.
items.quote: And if we see on the indirect cost side, there is an increase of almost Rs. 5.5 crores.

items.statement: NBFC will initially be funded through equity from the consolidated balance sheet, with potential capital raise in the next financial year.
items.quote: We'll run pilots using capital of our own to be able to demonstrate the robustness of the products that w e have. And then we can follow it with the capital raise in the new financial year

items.statement: Management generated INR75 crores cash in first half and holds over INR250 crores cash on balance sheet
items.quote: Now we have generated around INR75 crores of cash in the first half of the year. We have more than INR250 crores of cash line on balance sheet.

items.statement: IPO proceeds of Rs 240 crore allocated for debt repayment to reduce borrowings and improve debt-equity ratio
items.quote: We intend to allocate Rs. 240 crores from the net proceeds for the full or partial repayment or prepayment of certain company borrowings.

items.statement: Operating cash flow improved 83% year-on-year in H1 FY25 to Rs 19.8 crore from Rs 10.81 crore in H1 FY24
items.quote: Cash generations have been better this year, this half year for our cash from operations, which was about 10.81 gross no one before. 10.81 crores half year last year. This year we have been able to operations generated from operations above 19.8 crores, which is a growth of about 83%.

items.statement: Authorized share capital increased from INR 15 crores to INR 20 crores as a precaution for future corporate actions since issued capital was near the ceiling.
items.quote: I think the authorized was INR15 crores and INR14.6 or something was already issued out of that. So we did that so that if we have to take any corporate action. So we can - we have a scope for that.

items.statement: Acquired 100% stake in Jet Inks Private Limited, a subsidiary since 2002, to enhance market presence in Southern and Eastern India and contribute to 20% revenue increase.
items.quote: Aztec has recently also acquired Jet Inks Private Limited, a 100% acquired subsidiary, well established name in the industrial printing sector since 2002, known for its expertise in compatible ink and additives.
